title: Mormon Addresses the Gentiles
summary: Mormon addresses the Gentiles and says Jesus Christ commanded him to speak concerning them and to write.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon says Jesus Christ commanded him to speak concerning the Gentiles and to write.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Mormon may be shown preparing to write.
unspecified_visual_details: Mormon's appearance, surroundings, and writing materials are not specified.
No appearance of Jesus Christ is described.

narration.text: Hearken, O ye Gentiles, and hear the words of Jesus Christ, the Son of the living God, which he hath commanded me that I should speak concerning you, for, behold he commandeth me that I should write, saying:

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Jesus Christ is identified as the Son of the living God.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Jesus Christ appearing in this scene.
Do not invent specific writing materials or a setting.
Do not add the words that follow “saying:”.

title: The Invitation to Repent
summary: Jesus Christ commands the Gentiles to turn from wickedness, repent, come unto him, be baptized in his name, and receive remission of sins and the Holy Ghost, so they may be numbered with his people of the house of Israel.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus Christ commands the Gentiles to turn from wickedness and repent.
Jesus Christ commands them to come unto him and be baptized in his name.
The stated purpose is that they may receive remission of sins, be filled with the Holy Ghost, and be numbered with his people of the house of Israel.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The command can be conveyed as off-screen speech over a neutral, non-specific setting.
unspecified_visual_details: No visible people or specific setting are described.
No baptism, repentance, or reception of the Holy Ghost is narrated as occurring.

spoken_dialogue.text: Turn, all ye Gentiles, from your wicked ways; and repent of your evil doings
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: This verse is a command and invitation, not a report that the Gentiles acted on it.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Gentiles actually repenting, being baptized, or receiving the Holy Ghost.
Do not literalize the promised filling with the Holy Ghost as a visible event.
